name: brainstorming-tree
description: Lightweight Agent Plugin for durable human-AI brainstorming. It persists ideas as an auditable tree so multi-round explorations survive context loss and every judgment is recorded.

interface.longDescription: Moves brainstorming state out of model context into a local, auditable idea tree. The human asks, the agent proposes materially different leaves, the human gives feedback, and every comparison lands in the ledger; sessions resume across context loss.
defaultPrompt: 把这个问题建成创意树，先提两三个实质不同的方向给我看
读取现有创意树，继续上次的讨论
读取这棵创意树，告诉我目前最强的候选和它赢在哪条比较上
